Remove named charts from a gsm.kri chart list

DropChart.Rd

gsm.kri::MakeCharts() returns, for each metric, a list of widgets keyed by chart type. gsm.kri::Report_MetricCharts() renders whatever that list contains, so a chart can be suppressed by dropping it here rather than by forking the report template.

Usage

DropChart(lCharts, strChart = "scatterPlot")

Arguments

lCharts

list Named list of per-metric chart lists, as returned by gsm.kri::MakeCharts().

strChart

character Chart keys to drop, e.g. "scatterPlot".

Value

lCharts with the named charts removed from every metric. Metrics that never had the chart are returned unchanged.

Details

This exists because the stock scatter plot is not meaningful for CTAS. It plots Denominator on x against Numerator on y, which suits a rate metric where the denominator is exposure. For CTAS the denominator is the number of timeseries evaluated for the feature, which is identical across sites unless a site lacks a parameter altogether, so the points collapse onto one or two x positions.

Examples

lCharts <- list(
  Analysis_ctas0001 = list(scatterPlot = 1, barChart = 2, metricTable = 3)
)
names(DropChart(lCharts, "scatterPlot")$Analysis_ctas0001)
#> [1] "barChart"    "metricTable"
